description: Create a feedback comment on an asset, as the connected user. Pass an asset id (the comment lands on its current version) or a version id (that exact version). content is Markdown (a heading, lists, bold, links, @mentions as links - see the content parameter). PREFER passing timestamp (seconds into the video) whenever the source material has one - e.g. when importing feedback from an email like 'at 0:42 the logo is wrong', convert 0:42 to 42. Without timestamp the comment is a general (non-anchored) note. tags applies the team's EXISTING tags by name (see the tags tool); statuses are tags too. Use reply_to to reply in an existing thread: the reply lands on the version that thread is on (even after a newer version was uploaded), and takes no tags or timestamp (those belong to the thread's root comment - passing them is refused). Cannot add recordings or drawings; an image only by the url of one already in Flask.

asset_id.description: Asset id (current version) or version id to comment on (with reply_to: the asset the thread is on)

content.description: The comment body in Markdown. Supported: headings (one level - any number of # makes the same heading), bulleted and numbered lists, **bold**, *italic*, `code`, fenced code blocks, links; a single newline is a line break. Mention a person (they are notified) with [@Name](https://flask.do/members?user=USER_ID) - user ids come from the members tool; a plain @Name is just text. Reference an asset with its flask.do/a/ASSET_ID link, another feedback item with its url, and a moment of the video with [0:26](#t=26) or a range [0:26-0:31](#t=26,31). An image already in Flask (a url from an item's images) goes on a line of its own as ![](url); any other image stays a link. Anything else (quotes, tables, HTML) stays literal text. At most 20,000 characters of text.

reply_to.description: Feedback item id to reply to (threads the comment under it; a reply to a reply joins the same thread)

tags.description: Tag NAMES to apply (must already exist in the team - see the tags tool). Not allowed with reply_to.

timestamp.description: Video time in SECONDS the comment refers to (e.g. 72.5 for 1:12.5). Strongly preferred when known; omit for a general comment. Not allowed with reply_to.

name: feedback_post
